Name: Shopping Festival
Author: zzzzzzzhao
Description:
[b]鹈鹕镇购物节[/b]为《星露谷物语》新增一个每年秋季11日举办的节日。上午9点起进入小镇，沿着熟悉的街道寻找店主们的临时摊位，购买补给、完成交换、收集印章，也和来逛集市的居民聊聊天。节日默认开放至晚上10点。
这里既适合为农场囤货，也适合带着材料慢慢探索。即使预算不多，你也能从免费试吃、健康咨询和物资挑战开始，收获自己的购物节奖励。
[heading]01｜熟悉的小镇，秋日的新摊位[/heading]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288393-1839544628.png[/img]
原版建筑与秋日摊位
购物节沿用原版小镇的建筑与道路，在街边和空地加入木质货架、条纹棚顶、南瓜、秋日彩旗与灯笼。你可以在熟悉的街区里寻找新摊位，店铺名称会在交互或购物界面中出现，留给你自己探索的乐趣。
12位摊主参加集市：[b]皮埃尔、莫里斯、罗宾、克林特、玛妮、威利、格斯、哈维、桑迪、科罗布斯、法师和马龙[/b]。其他参会居民也有购物节相关对话。
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288427-313702829.png[/img]
随着节日时间推进，场景逐渐染上暮色，摊位灯笼亮起暖光。逛完白天的货架，也可以留下来感受傍晚的集市。
[heading]02｜七折购物[/heading]
节日普通货架的金币售价按基础价格的[b]70%[/b]计算，最低为1g。皮埃尔保留当前季节与玩家条件对应的商品；其他商店扩展了日常轮换商品的展示范围。格斯除酒吧货物与可购买食谱外，还提供更丰富的料理选择。
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288454-753496657.png[/img]
从种子、建材、矿石、饲料到鱼饵、料理与冒险装备，你可以根据自己的农场计划采购。法师还设有独立的魔法用品货架。
[b]套餐、盲袋、会员礼包与物品交换采用各自页面标明的条件，不再额外叠加七折；以物易物商品也不按金币折扣换算。[/b]摊位购买的是商品，动物购买、建筑施工与工具升级等原店服务不属于本节的摊位购物内容。
[heading]03｜12家摊位各有活动[/heading]
除了购买商品，店主们还准备了材料交换、免费体验与补给礼包。挑战界面会显示需求、当前进度和奖励，确认完成后才会提交所需物品。

[heading]04｜F8购物护照：集章、找摊位、领奖励[/heading]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288501-619362225.png[/img]

在节日场景按 [b]F8[/b] 打开购物护照，查看各店盖章状态、活动和方位提示，也可以在这里兑换奖励或结束购物节。
默认奖励门槛为：
[list]
[*][b]3枚印章：[/b]秋季野种子礼包。[/*]
[*][b]6枚印章：[/b]装饰家具。[/*]
[*][b]8枚印章：[/b]南瓜灯与购物节纪念章。[/*]
[/list]每档奖励每届可领取一次；印章不会因领奖而扣除。若一次达到多个门槛，可再次点击领取其余已解锁奖励。新一年的购物节会刷新本届进度。
[heading]05｜Joja积分：不只靠花钱[/heading]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288520-997137144.png[/img]
Joja印章不要求购买会员，也不消耗积分。[b]交出5个秋季作物，或在Joja累计消费300g，任选其一[/b]，即可完成挑战并领取Joja印章、20积分和5个秋季野种子。
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288533-1274645534.png[/img]

[heading]06｜四种特别的摊位风格[/heading]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288551-776806059.png[/img]
[b]法师：[/b]紫金棚布、星月纹样与魔法摆件，把森林里的神秘气氛带进集市。
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288567-1569404052.png[/img]
[b]科罗布斯：[/b]深色石拱、苔绿色调与幽暗货架，保留他安静而奇特的个性。
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288579-1673523750.png[/img]
[b]桑迪：[/b]青绿色织物、金色纹样与仙人掌装饰，带来绿洲商店的异域气息。
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288587-1450196233.png[/img]
[b]马龙：[/b]森林绿棚顶、盾牌和装备展示，呈现冒险者公会的实用风格。
[heading]07｜日历提醒与中英双语[/heading]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288599-920214708.png[/img]
秋季11日会在原生日历上显示节日旗帜，并与乔迪的生日一起提示。模组支持[b]简体中文和英语[/b]，随游戏语言自动切换，覆盖居民对话、购物护照、挑战、积分菜单、信件与纪念品描述。

[code]Mods[/code]文件夹。[/*]

[*]走到摊位柜台前交互，选择购物、挑战或活动；按F8随时查看护照。[/*]
[/list]更新时先关闭游戏，再替换模组文件夹。自定义过节日时间或集章门槛的玩家可保留自己的
[code]config.json[/code]。
[b]带上作物、木材、矿石和几条不同的鱼，给自己留一个慢慢逛街的秋日。[/b]
[line]



[heading]A new reason to look forward to Fall 11[/heading]

[quote]Bring a shopping bag—and a little of your harvest. Discounted shelves, shopkeeper challenges, passport stamps, and festival rewards await in autumnal Pelican Town.[/quote][b]Pelican Town Shopping Festival[/b] adds an annual festival on [b]Fall 11[/b], open by default from [b]9:00 AM to 10:00 PM[/b]. Enter town, explore the shopkeepers' temporary stalls, stock up for your farm, trade materials, and catch up with residents enjoying the market.
Spend the day bargain hunting or take a slower route through the challenges. Free tasting, a health consultation, and material donations offer ways to join in even when your budget is small.
[heading]01 | Your familiar town, dressed for autumn[/heading]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288684-1854606624.png[/img]
Autumn stalls beside the original town buildings
The festival keeps the original town's buildings and streets, adding wooden counters, striped awnings, pumpkins, bunting, and lanterns to existing streets and open spaces. Discover each stall as you explore; store names appear during interactions and shopping rather than on floating signs above the awnings.
Meet [b]12 vendors: Pierre, Morris, Robin, Clint, Marnie, Willy, Gus, Harvey, Sandy, Krobus, the Wizard, and Marlon[/b]. Other attending residents also have shopping festival dialogue.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288695-557445897.png[/img]
As festival time advances, the market takes on a gentle evening tint and the stall lanterns glow. Stay a little longer to enjoy the autumn atmosphere.
[heading]02 | Shop at 30% off[/heading]
Regular festival shelves charge [b]70% of their base gold prices[/b], with a minimum price of 1g. Pierre's stock follows the current season and player conditions. Other shops broaden their selection by relaxing daily stock rotations, while Gus offers an expanded selection of cooked dishes alongside saloon goods and purchasable recipes.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288704-1590164487.png[/img]
Browse seeds, building materials, ore, ranch supplies, fishing gear, meals, and adventure equipment. The Wizard also brings a dedicated shelf of magical supplies.
[b]Bundles, mystery bags, membership packages, and exchanges use their displayed prices or material requirements; the regular shelf discount does not stack onto them. Barter costs are not reduced as gold prices.[/b] These stalls sell goods; animal purchases, building construction, and tool upgrade services are outside the festival stall shopping system.
[heading]03 | A small activity at every stall[/heading]
Shopping is only part of the day. Shopkeepers also offer donations, free experiences, material exchanges, and supply packages. Challenge menus show requirements, progress, and rewards before you confirm a submission.
Spending a total of [b]300g at a stall's regular festival shop[/b] also earns that stall's stamp. [b]Purchase stamps and challenge rewards are tracked separately:[/b] earning a stamp through shopping does not prevent you from claiming an unfinished challenge. Each shop contributes only one stamp.
[heading]04 | Your shopping passport[/heading]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288718-2030620370.png[/img]
Press [b]F8[/b] during the festival to open your passport. Check stamp progress, look up activities and stall directions, claim rewards, or end your visit.
Default reward milestones are:
[list]
[*][b]3 stamps:[/b] a Fall Seeds bundle.[/*]
[*][b]6 stamps:[/b] decorative furniture.[/*]
[*][b]8 stamps:[/b] a Jack-O-Lantern and a festival medallion.[/*]
[/list]Each tier can be claimed once per festival, and claiming rewards does not spend your stamps. If you unlock several tiers at once, use the claim button again for the remaining unlocked rewards. Festival progress resets for the following year's event.
[heading]05 | Joja points, with more ways to earn[/heading]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288728-1669419217.png[/img]
No membership or points are required for the Joja stamp challenge. [b]Donate 5 fall crops OR spend 300g at Joja[/b], then complete the challenge to claim the Joja stamp, 20 points, and 5 Fall Seeds.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288740-1477724730.png[/img]
There are several additional ways to earn points:
Partial spending amounts carry forward. Redeem points for a [b]20-point seed bundle[/b], [b]80-point mining supplies[/b], or [b]100-point commemorative furniture[/b], each once per festival. An optional [b]2,000g membership package[/b] includes supplies and 20 points; membership is not needed for the stamp challenge or standard point activities.
[heading]06 | Four distinctive stalls[/heading]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288749-1487597357.png[/img]
[b]The Wizard:[/b] purple and gold fabric, moon-and-star motifs, and magical curios bring a little forest mystery into town.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288763-1207725346.png[/img]
[b]Krobus:[/b] a dark stone arch, mossy colors, and a quiet shadowy counter suit his unusual little shop.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288772-275956113.png[/img]
[b]Sandy:[/b] turquoise textiles, gold patterns, and cactus decorations bring the atmosphere of the Oasis to the festival.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288782-1080649367.png[/img]
[b]Marlon:[/b] a forest-green canopy, shield, and equipment display give his stall an Adventurer's Guild identity.
[heading]07 | Calendar support and two languages[/heading]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54066/54066-1792288792-1770784422.png[/img]
Fall 11 appears on the native calendar with a festival flag, alongside Jodi's birthday. The mod supports [b]English and Simplified Chinese[/b], following the game's language automatically across resident dialogue, the passport, challenges, points menus, letters, and keepsake descriptions.
[heading]Installation and getting started[/heading]
[list]
[*]Install Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.[/*]
[*]Extract the package's
[code]PelicanTownShoppingFestival[/code]folder into your game's
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI and enter town after 9:00 AM on Fall 11.[/*]
[*]Interact at a stall counter to shop or choose an activity. Press F8 to open your passport.[/*]
[/list]Close the game before updating the mod. Keep your own
[code]config.json[/code]if you have customized the festival hours or stamp milestones.
[b]Pack some crops, wood, ore, and a few different fish—and leave yourself an autumn day to browse.[/b]
